description: Retiring release-cut needs a replacement that synchronizes everything a release touches. `make release-prep VERSION=X.Y.Z` (via scripts/update_version.py and scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py) updates pyproject version, uv.lock, CHANGELOG.md, documentation version markers, and the landing badge, producing one normal PR through the queue. `make release-check VERSION=X.Y.Z` verifies that complete state locally and in release.yml (version equality everywhere, changelog entry present, lock revision, curation rules from check_release_curation.py, dependency bounds with --fail-on=cap-reached).
